name: Olive Farmer

intro.text: Careful of the trees. They're older than your country.
If you want to fight me, you'll have to do it politely and avoiding the olives.

win: Aye, well. The harvest starts tomorrow, and I've an excuse for being late.
after: My great-grandfather planted these. He said 'plant a tree for those who come after.' I planted three. One of them died.
